Get Flanders Heritage layers containing final archaeological reports (eindverslagen)

get_oe_eindverslagen.Rd

`get_oe_eindverslagen()` get an OGC Simple Features collection containing the final reports of archeological excavation projects, submitted to Flanders Heritage within two years of the completion of fieldwork.

Usage

get_oe_eindverslagen()

Value

An object of class sf (see st_read). The object has a comment containing the retrieval_time and retrieval_url.

Examples

get_oe_eindverslagen()
#> Simple feature collection with 1666 features and 7 fields
#> Geometry type: MULTIPOLYGON
